no-console.reason: The sources of ireko had 0 console calls on 2026-11-25, and the count stays at 0. Each console call fails from 2026-12-23. Output for a person goes to the printer of @mark1russell7/text, and a diagnostic goes to a log record of @mark1russell7/otel-ts.

typed-scripts.reason: The 13 JavaScript files of 2026-11-25: 8 scripts and configs, and 5 modules that @mark1russell7/vex-compiler writes as JavaScript with a .d.ts file. The list only gets shorter, and a new JavaScript file fails. The end: each script and config is TypeScript, and the compiler writes TypeScript or the files leave the rule as generated output.

typed-files.reason: The 47 TypeScript files of packages/site and the two configs of packages/ireko of 2026-11-25. The tsconfig of the site needs astro sync before tsc can list its files. The list only gets shorter, and a new file fails. The end: the site and its e2e specs are in a tsconfig that the typecheck script examines.

tsconfig-test.reason: The site has no tsconfig.test.json on 2026-11-25. The end: the same change as typed-files adds it, with its typecheck.

runner-budget.reason: The matrix of the job check in ci.yml has no max-parallel (3 versions of Node.js, so the budget holds). The end: ci.yml calls reusable-ci.yml of the template (rule shared-ci), which sets it.

playwright-install.reason: ci.yml and pages.yml install Chromium with their own command. The end: ci.yml calls reusable-ci.yml (rule shared-ci) and pages.yml calls reusable-pages.yml (rule pages-site): the shared workflows use setup-playwright.

shared-ci.off: ci.yml runs its own jobs: the Node.js matrix, the package smoke, the site with e2e tests, the module bytes and the release check. release.yml calls ci.yml as its verify job. The end: a pull request that moves ci.yml to reusable-ci.yml of the template, with its differences as inputs, and the word of the owner for the change to the release path.

pages-site.off: pages.yml builds and deploys the site with its own jobs (share cards, e2e tests). The end: a pull request that moves pages.yml to reusable-pages.yml of the template, with .github/site.json.
